Small sample PDFs used by the tests. Keep each one under 100 KB.

- `valid.pdf`: 2-3 pages of medical text that mentions a gene, protein, disease and drug (for example metformin and type 2 diabetes)
- `empty.pdf`: a PDF with a blank page and no text
- `image_only.pdf`: a scanned page saved as an image, with no text layer
- `encrypted.pdf`: a password-protected PDF
